title: Monkeys arrive at seashore
introduction: Monkeys on arriving at seashore are awestruck to have a glimpse of unnavigable ocean, which is tumultuous with many sea-creatures. Angada noticing the baffle of monkeys pacifies them and elicits information about each monkey's capability to jump over the ocean.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे चतुः षष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 64th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
आख्याता गृध्र राजेन समुत्प्लुत्य प्लवंगमाः |
संगताः प्रीति संयुक्ता विनेदुः सिंह विक्रमाः
verses.iast:
ākhyātā gṛdhra rājena samut.hplutya plavaṃgamāḥ |
saṃgatāḥ prīti saṃyuktā vineduḥ siṃha vikramāḥ
verses.translation: Those lion-hearted fly-jumpers who are informed thus by the kingly eagle Sampaati have gladly jumped and loped and screamed in league

glosses.meaning: by eagle, king, those who are informed - monkeys

verses.devanagari:
संपातेः वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरयो रावण क्षयम् |
हृष्टाः सागरम् आजग्मुः सीता दर्शन कान्क्षिणः
verses.iast:
sampāteḥ vacanam śrutvā harayo rāvaṇa kṣayam |
hṛṣṭāḥ sāgaram ājagmuḥ sītā darśana kānkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Sampaati, the monkeys have delightedly come to the ocean to go to the residence of Ravana, longing for a glimpse of Seetha.

glosses.meaning: Seetha, a glimpse of, longing for
come, and went - they have arrived.

verses.devanagari:
अभिक्रम्य तु तम् देशम् ददृशुर् भीम विक्रमाः |
कृत्स्नम् लोकस्य महतः प्रतिबिंबम् इव स्थितम्
verses.iast:
abhikramya tu tam deśam dadṛśur bhīma vikramāḥ |
kṛtsnam lokasya mahataḥ pratibimbam iva sthitam
verses.translation: Passing across that province those superbly venturesome monkeys have seen the ocean available there, appearing like a great mirror image of the world in it entirety.
notes: Here the word pratibimba is taken as entire ocean with its shores, and the ocean is said as a mirror, 'a mirror framed by it shores.' Thus, the ocean is said to contain all the items of entire world and it is becoming a world by itself, together with its own paraphernalia, from fishes to sharks, pebbles to diamonds etc. This is according to Govindaraja.

glosses.meaning: great, mirror-image, like [appearing to be,] available [ocean]

verses.devanagari:
दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य समासाद्य उत्तराम् दिशम् |
संनिवेशम् ततः चक्रुः सहिता वानर उत्तमाः
verses.iast:
dakṣiṇasya samudrasya samāsādya uttarām diśam |
saṃniveśam tataḥ cakruḥ sahitā vānara uttamāḥ
verses.translation:
On reaching the northern side of southern ocean those best monkeys have collectively made a camp there.

That ocean is uproarious with its tides, and with its gigantic and misshapen beings that are sporting in water with their wide-opened mouths.
notes: Here in this mms of Gorakhpur one verse is not given which is available in other versions. That verse is given here for an easy comprehension of the later verses.

verses.devanagari:
प्रसुप्तम् इव च अन्यत्र क्रीडन्तम् इव च अन्यतः |
क्वचित् पर्वत मात्रैः च जल राशिभिः आवृतम्
संकुलम् दानव इन्द्रैः च पाताल तल वासिभिः |
रोम हर्ष करम् दृष्ट्वा विषेदुः कपिकुंजराः
verses.iast:
prasuptam iva ca anyatra krīḍantam iva ca anyataḥ |
kvacit parvata mātraiḥ ca jala rāśibhiḥ āvṛtam
saṅkulam dānava indraiḥ ca pātāla tala vāsibhiḥ |
roma harṣa karam dṛṣṭvā viṣeduḥ kapikuṃjarāḥ
verses.translation: Somewhere that ocean is as though sleeping well, and somewhere else it is as though sporting, elsewhere it is overspread with tidewaters as high as mountains, somewhere else it is tumultuous with the best demonic beings who are the residents on the plane of netherworld, and the elephantine monkeys despaired on seeing such a hair-raising ocean..

glosses.meaning: with demonic, best being - demons living in paatala

verses.devanagari:
आकाशम् इव दुष्पारम् सागरम् प्रेक्ष्य वानराः |
विषेदुः सहिता सर्वे कथम् कार्यम् इति ब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
ākāśam iva duṣpāram sāgaram prekṣya vānarāḥ |
viṣeduḥ sahitā sarve katham kāryam iti bruvan
verses.translation: On seeing the shoreless ocean that is like an endless sky, hence unnavigable, the vanara-s are despaired and said each to each, "how to vault this ocean?"

glosses.meaning: sky [endless,] like, impossible, to navigate [shoreless, hence unnavigable]

verses.devanagari:
विषण्णाम् वाहिनीम् दृष्ट्वा सागरस्य निरीक्षणात् |
आश्वासयामास हरीन् भय आर्तान् हरि सत्तमः
verses.iast:
viṣaṇṇām vāhinīm dṛṣṭvā sāgarasya nirīkṣaṇāt |
āśvāsayāmāsa harīn bhaya ārtān hari sattamaḥ
verses.translation: Then the best one among monkeys, Angada, started to inspirit the army of monkeys who are anguished by fear on their gazing at the ocean.

verses.devanagari:
न विषादे मनः कार्यम् विषादो दोषवत्तरः |
विषादो हन्ति पुरुषम् बालम् क्रुद्ध इव उरगः
verses.iast:
na viṣāde manaḥ kāryam viṣādo doṣavattaraḥ |
viṣādo hanti puruṣam bālam kruddha iva uragaḥ
verses.translation: "Loosing heart to dismay is an unworkability, because dismaying itself is detrimental, and dismay alone ruins a person, as a vicious viper unworkably ruins an innocent child...

glosses.meaning: vicious, viper, [innocent] child, like, [ruins - a vicious viper unnecessarily ruins an innocent child]

verses.devanagari:
यो विषादो प्रसहते विक्रमे समुपस्थिते |
तेजसा तस्य हीनस्य पुरुष अर्थो न सिद्ध्यति
verses.iast:
yo viṣādo prasahate vikrame samupasthite |
tejasā tasya hīnasya puruṣa artho na siddhyati
verses.translation: "Individual achievement will be unachievable to him who readily braces himself with despair when the time for venturesomeness verges on, because of the lacking of his own vitality..." So said Angada and then the nightfall has occurred.
notes: These two sayings of Angada, and suchlike at other places, become precedent for the sayings of Krishna in Bhagavad Gita, esp., in the Ch. of arjuna viṣādayoga 'Arjuna's Despair'.

glosses.meaning: who, despair, readily tolerates [readily braces himself]
by vitality, one who is lacking, to him

verses.devanagari:
तस्याम् रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् अंगदो वानरैः सह |
हरि वृद्धैः समागम्य पुनर् मंत्रम् अमंत्रयत्
verses.iast:
tasyām rātryām vyatītāyām aṃgado vānaraiḥ saha |
hari vṛddhaiḥ samāgamya punar maṃtram amaṃtrayat
verses.translation: While that night is elapsing into the wee hours of next day, Angada met all the golden-ager monkeys, and again deliberated with them.

verses.devanagari:
सा वानराणाम् ध्वजिनी परिवार्य अंगदम् बभौ |
वासवम् परिवार्य इव मरुताम् वाहिनी स्थिता
verses.iast:
sā vānarāṇām dhvajinī parivārya aṃgadam babhau |
vāsavam parivārya iva marutām vāhinī sthitā
verses.translation: When those troops of monkey army stood encircling Angada, it beamed forth like the army of gods encircling Indra.

verses.devanagari:
को अन्यः ताम् वानरीम् सेनाम् शक्तः स्तंभयितुम् भवेत् |
अन्यत्र वालि तनयात् अन्यत्र च हनूमतः
verses.iast:
ko anyaḥ tām vānarīm senām śaktaḥ stambhayitum bhavet |
anyatra vāli tanayāt anyatra ca hanūmataḥ
verses.translation: Who can capably consolidate that army of monkeys, other than Vali's son Angada, or, other than Hanuma? None. Because that army itself is an army of fickly, tickly monkeys.
notes: Angada is the crown prince and Hanuma is [non-commissioned] commander-in-chief of monkey forces. It is usual in the military etiquette not to use high rankers in the first instance itself. Here also the same protocol is being followed. In this way, Duryodhana requests Bhishma to become his commander-in-chief:

anena sena patiH prabalaH kartavyam iti suucitam | tathaa ca udyoge bhaarate - bhiiShmam prati duryodhanaH - bhavaanushanasaa tulyo hita eShii ca sadaa mama | asamhaaryaH sthito dharme sa naH senaapatiH bhava || dk Now, excepting Angada and Hanuma, some other vaulter is needed.

glosses.meaning: than Vali's, son, differently - other than
to consolidate, capable, he will be.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तान् हरि वृद्धान् च तत् च सैन्यम् अरिन्दमः |
अनुमान्य अंगदः श्रीमान् वाक्यम् अर्थवत् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tān hari vṛddhān ca tat ca sainyam arindamaḥ |
anumānya aṃgadaḥ śrīmān vākyam arthavat abravīt
verses.translation: Then that enemy-subjugator and illustrious Angada, on revering the old-ager monkeys and paying due respects to the army of monkeys, spoke this meaningful sentence.

verses.devanagari:
क इदानीम् महातेजा लंघयिष्यति सागरम् |
कः करिष्यति सुग्रीवम् सत्य सन्धम् अरिन्दमम्
verses.iast:
ka idānīm mahātejā laṃghayiṣyati sāgaram |
kaḥ kariṣyati sugrīvam satya sandham arindamam
verses.translation: "Now, who is that great-resplendent one who can vault over the ocean and who is he who can facilitate the enemy-repressor Sugreeva to become truthful to his word...

verses.devanagari:
को वीरो योजन शतम् लंघयेत प्लवंगमाः |
इमान् च यूथपान् सर्वान् मोचयेत् को महाभयात्
verses.iast:
ko vīro yojana śatam laṃghayeta plavaṃgamāḥ |
imān ca yūthapān sarvān mocayet ko mahābhayāt
verses.translation: "Who is that brave hurdler who can hurdle over a hundred yojana distance, oh, fly-jumpers, who is he who can even emancipate all these monkey commanders from the great fear of Sugreeva...

verses.devanagari:
कस्य प्रसादात् दारान् च पुत्रान् चैव गृहाणि च |
इतो निवृत्ताः पश्येम सिद्ध अर्थाः सुखिनो वयम्
verses.iast:
kasya prasādāt dārān ca putrān caiva gṛhāṇi ca |
ito nivṛttāḥ paśyema siddha arthāḥ sukhino vayam
verses.translation: "By whose benignancy we can rejoicingly see our wives, sons, houses and homes on going back from here after achieving the purpose of our task...

verses.devanagari:
कस्य प्रसादात् रामम् च लक्ष्मणम् च महाबलम् |
अभिगच्छेम संहृष्टाः सुग्रीवम् च महाबलम्
verses.iast:
kasya prasādāt rāmam ca lakṣmaṇam ca mahābalam |
abhigacchema saṃhṛṣṭāḥ sugrīvam ca mahābalam
verses.translation: "By whose benevolence we can unworriedly approach Rama, or even that irascible Lakshmana, or ruthless Sugreeva, as well...

glosses.meaning: great-mighty one [here, ruthless one,] to Sugreeva, as well

verses.devanagari:
यदि कश्चित् समर्थो वः सागर प्लवने हरिः |
स ददातु इह नः शीघ्रम् पुण्याम् अभय दक्षिणाम्
verses.iast:
yadi kaścit samartho vaḥ sāgara plavane hariḥ |
sa dadātu iha naḥ śīghram puṇyām abhaya dakṣiṇām
verses.translation: "If someone among you is competent enough to jump over the ocean, that monkey may now quickly give us all, a munificence, called a solemn impunity from Sugreeva..." Angada addressed monkeys in this way.

verses.devanagari:
अंगदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा न कश्चित् किंचित् अब्रवीत् |
स्तिमिता इव अभवत् सर्वा सा तत्र हरि वाहिनी
verses.iast:
aṃgadasya vacaḥ śrutvā na kaścit kiñcit abravīt |
stimitā iva abhavat sarvā sā tatra hari vāhinī
verses.translation: On hearing Angada's words there is none someone to say something in that matter, as the entire monkey troop is as though dumbfounded.

verses.devanagari:
पुनर् एव अंगदः प्राह तान् हरीन् हरि सत्तमः |
सर्वे बलवताम् श्रेष्ठा भवन्तो दृढ विक्रमाः |
व्यपदेश्य कुले जाताः पूजिताः च अपि अभीक्ष्णशः
verses.iast:
punar eva aṃgadaḥ prāha tān harīn hari sattamaḥ |
sarve balavatām śreṣṭhā bhavanto dṛḍha vikramāḥ |
vyapadeśya kule jātāḥ pūjitāḥ ca api abhīkṣṇaśaḥ
verses.translation: Again that best one among monkeys Angada clearly said to those monkeys thus, "all of you are the best ones among powerful monkeys, you all are determinedly venturesome, born in flawless families and even adored again and again for your adventures...

glosses.meaning: you, all of you, among the powerful, the best
again and again, adored ones [for your adventures,] also, even.

verses.devanagari:
न हि वो गमने संगः कदाचित् अपि कस्यचित् भवेत् |
ब्रुवध्वम् यस्य या शक्तिः प्लवने प्लवगर्षभाः
verses.iast:
na hi vo gamane saṃgaḥ kadācit api kasyacit bhavet |
bruvadhvam yasya yā śaktiḥ plavane plavagarṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: "There will be no barrier to whomsoever, whensoever he wanted essay wheresoever, isn't it! Hence, oh, best fly-jumpers, each one you may give an account as to which one has got which capability in jump-leaping the ocean.

glosses.meaning: in going [jumping,] barrier, not, will be there, isn't it
whose, what, capability - is there, that
